get.summary: List coupons with filters and paging
get.description:
Paginated coupon listing with search, platform, accessibility, status, device-type, privacy and date-range filters. Each row gets a calculatedStatus (active/inactive/upcoming/expired) plus usage counters for the UI progress bars.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Note the fromDate/toDate filters overwrite the startDate/endDate constraints that the `status` filter sets, so combining them can produce unexpected results.

_Source: `app/api/coupons/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across code, title and description

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: active | inactive | expired | upcoming. Computed from isActive plus the start/end dates.

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Matches coupons whose deviceTypes array contains this value

parameters.name: isPrivate
parameters.description: 'false' shows only public coupons, 'true' only secret ones. Omit to show both.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Upper bound on endDate, made inclusive by rolling forward one day

parameters.name: includeGenerated
parameters.description: Set to 'true' to include the single-use bonus coupons the backend mints per redeemed token. Hidden by default - they outnumber real campaigns roughly 60 to 1.

post.description:
Zod-validates and creates a coupon campaign. Coupon codes are unique. maxUsers is forced to null when userLimitType is AllCustomers, and an empty brand selection is stored as NULL so the coupon applies to every brand of its device types.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check - the session is read only to attribute the activity log entry. Affects live customer discounts. Audited via withAuditLog as COUPON and logged with logEntityCreation.

_Source: `app/api/coupons/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

put.description:
Full replace of a coupon using the same schema as POST, with the id supplied in the JSON body. Rejects a code change that would collide with another coupon.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. usedCount is not reset by an update. Audited via withAuditLog as COUPON and logged with logEntityUpdate.

_Source: `app/api/coupons/route.ts`_

patch.description:
Inline-edit endpoint that writes one whitelisted column on one coupon. Date fields are coerced to Date, brand is normalised to NULL when empty, and switching userLimitType to AllCustomers clears maxUsers.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. The field name IS whitelisted here (unlike /api/brands/field). Audited via withAuditLog as COUPON.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check - unauthenticated destructive delete. DESTRUCTIVE: also hard-deletes the coupon's entire redemption history (customerCoupon rows), so past usage data is lost. Audited via withAuditLog as COUPON and logged with logEntityDeletion.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

ErrorDetailsEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ error, details }` where `details` is a string (usually the underlying exception message).

UnspecifiedObject.description: Response body shape not captured by the source re-audit (only the status code was detected). Any JSON object.

AnyObject.description: Arbitrary JSON object; the route forwards or stores it without declaring a shape.

deviceType.description: All | LaptopLanding | MobileLanding | TabletLanding | HomeLanding | MacLanding | CameraLanding | WatchLanding | ConsoleLanding | HeadphoneLanding

startDate.description: ISO date the banner starts showing

endDate.description: ISO date the banner stops showing

deviceType.description: All | LaptopLanding | MobileLanding | TabletLanding | HomeLanding | MacLanding | CameraLanding | WatchLanding | ConsoleLanding | HeadphoneLanding

code.description: Coupon code, 3-20 chars; must be unique

maxUsers.description: Maximum distinct users. Required (min 1) when userLimitType is Custom; stored as null for AllCustomers.

startDate.description: ISO datetime the coupon becomes valid

isPrivate.description: Secret coupon, hidden from the default listing. Defaults to false.

deviceTypes.description: Array of device type strings the coupon applies to

brand.description: JSON array of brand ids as a string. An empty string, '[]' or an empty array is normalised to NULL, which means all brands.

id.description: Coupon id to update. Optional in the Zod schema but the handler 400s without it.

code.description: Coupon code, 3-20 chars; must stay unique

brand.description: JSON array of brand ids; empty is normalised to NULL (all brands)

field.description: One of code, title, description, platform, discount, maxUses, maxUsers, userLimitType, startDate, endDate, accessibility, isActive, isPrivate, deviceTypes, minValue, maxValue, brand. Anything else 400s.

isActive.description: New active state. Must be present or the route 400s.

MessageEnvelope.description: Message-only envelope `{ message }`; used for both success and failure responses.

SuccessMessageEnvelope.description: Envelope `{ success, message }`; `success` is `true` on 2xx and `false` on error responses.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

InternalServerError.description: Internal server error - unhandled failure inside the route handler. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

BadRequest.description: Bad request / validation error - a required field is missing or invalid. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

NotFound.description: Not found - the referenced record does not exist. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

Conflict.description: Conflict - the record already exists or its current state does not allow this change. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

UntypedJsonBody.description: JSON body accepted as-is; the route does not declare a shape (forwarded upstream or validated inside the handler).

FromParam.name: from
FromParam.description: Window start (YYYY-MM-DD, IST). Defaults to 30 days before today.

ToParam.name: to
ToParam.description: Window end (YYYY-MM-DD, IST). Defaults to today.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
